theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_puvd_measure_eq_sum_planes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n q : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → R.Represents C → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) → (∀ x ∈ C.support, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, x ∈ Ps i) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ i, R.measure (A ∩ ((Ps i : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0}))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
